standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → roz-corpus-base → family-conjugate (this file) → record variant → scene override
attitude: the A′ family is the technological face of its A operation: the same underlying grammar (family-argument) re-sited on instituted, inspectable surfaces — the lattice, not the manuscript

grammar.shares: family-argument: one governing formation shaped by the record's operation; one editorial text layer (kicker '<record id> · <CLAIM_STATUS>' / title / italic relations / body compressed from the record); same scene rhythm; same status encoding

text_layers.title_card: layer 1: kicker '<record id> · <CLAIM_STATUS>' + record title, left margin (x .033, width 340)
text_layers.relations: layer 2: the declared relation line as its own italic layer (x .033, y .26, width 290) — wraps fully in the left margin, clear of the field's left edge (E0 acceptance repair)
text_layers.body: layer 3: the record's own governing proposition and operation, compressed from the record only (x .033, y .50, width 600)

material_treatment.note: print material on a cooler paper ground: the registered treatment distinguishing the technological face from the A family's ink-on-warm-paper, while scene construction, entity vocabulary and text grammar stay shared
material_treatment.reason: the conjugate records re-site each A operation at the technological register; the instituted lattice reads as print — an imperfect, checkable surface

status_encoding.note: presentation-only encoding of the record's frontmatter claim_status; identical values to family-argument

variation_rules: each A′ scene mirrors its A partner's operation (the record declares the re-siting), not a bespoke invention
per-scene variation is explicit and small: one or two field params, palette accent, formation shape/sequence
no ornament without an argumentative job; a quiet record stays quiet
venue citations carried by A′ records (brief q-references, scenario modality) stay inside text layers and bindings — never attributed to the field itself
